title: Best of the Red River Delta in 5 days
summary: Hanoi, one Ha Long boat, then Trang An and Tam Coc. This is the delta, not the mountains.

days.title: Day 1 — Old Quarter
days.body: Land in Hanoi and walk the Old Quarter north of Hoan Kiem Lake.

days.title: Day 2 — Lake and citadel
days.body: Walk Hoan Kiem Lake, see the Imperial Citadel of Thang Long, and eat bun cha.

days.title: Day 3 — Ha Long
days.body: Take route 2 from the Ha Long passenger port: Ti Top, Sung Sot, and Luon on one boat, clocked at 5–6 hours.

days.title: Day 4 — Trang An
days.body: Sit the sampan at Trang An, and walk Hoa Lu if the morning is still open.

days.title: Day 5 — Tam Coc
days.body: Take the sampan through the three caves, about 2 hours on the water. Hang Mua is the stair for the view over the valley, and its time is Check on arrival.

seoTitle: 5 days in the Red River Delta
seoDescription: Hanoi, a Ha Long boat, Trang An, and the Tam Coc sampan in five days.
